## What changed and why

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and scope. Link the relevant issue or acceptance record.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. For UI changes, include the rendered desktop evidence. For installer changes, include a fresh-install receipt. State remaining gaps; old screenshots or checks do not verify new behavior.

## Documentation and handoff

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` records this change with its actual timestamp and validation.
- [ ] `README.md` reflects any setup or behavior changes, if applicable.
- [ ] `AI_USAGE.md` reflects any meaningful Codex contribution, if applicable.
- [ ] The code uses simple patterns and includes no credentials or private data.
- [ ] Source identities, retained evidence and error/recovery behavior remain truthful.
- [ ] Dependency changes preserve the lockfile and third-party notices; audit findings are disclosed.
